info.title: Google Sheets MCP REST API
info.description: REST API for managing Google Sheets spreadsheets. For use with ChatGPT Custom Actions.

get.summary: Find a row by column value
get.description: The 1-based number of the first row whose cell in column col equals val (exact, as displayed). Scans at most maxRows rows from startRow. Mirrors the MCP tool `findRowByValue`. Returns JSON; found is false when no row matches.

parameters.name: col
parameters.description: Column letters to search, e.g. A or AA. A cell reference is refused.

parameters.name: sheet
parameters.description: Tab name. Defaults to the first tab.

400.description: col or val missing, or col is not column letters

get.summary: Read a range from a spreadsheet
get.description: GET sibling of POST /api/v1/sheets/{spreadsheetId}/read. Mirrors the MCP tool `readSpreadsheet`. Returns JSON, or the MCP text rendering with ?format=text or Accept: text/plain.

parameters.name: valueRenderOption
parameters.description: FORMATTED_VALUE (the default) as displayed, UNFORMATTED_VALUE for the raw value, FORMULA for the formula text.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: text for the MCP tool rendering; JSON otherwise.

400.description: range missing, or an unknown valueRenderOption

post.summary: Find a row by a column value and write one field of it, named by header
post.description: Shipped on the owner request for full REST coverage of non-destructive writes. Row 1 holds the headers. Finds the first row whose searchColumn equals searchValue and writes newValue into the column headed fieldName, returning the old value. No matching row is a 404 and an unknown header a 400 with availableHeaders; neither writes anything. searchColumn must be column letters. A sheetName with spaces or apostrophes is quoted for you. updatedCells 1 confirms the write.

searchColumn.description: Column letters to search in (e.g. "A" or "AA"). A cell reference such as "A2" is refused with 400.

searchValue.description: The value to search for (exact match) to locate the row.

fieldName.description: The header name of the column to update.

newValue.description: The new value to write into the cell.

sheetName.description: Sheet/tab name. Defaults to the first sheet.

400.description: Invalid request body, searchColumn not column letters, or fieldName is not a header (availableHeaders lists them)

404.description: Spreadsheet not found, or no row has searchValue in searchColumn

post.summary: Add a tab to a spreadsheet, optionally sized
post.description: Shipped on the owner request for full REST coverage of non-destructive writes. Adds a sheet/tab. Google sizes a new tab at 1000 rows x 26 columns and a write does not grow the grid, so pass rowCount/columnCount when the data is bigger. Answers 201 with the sheet properties Google reports (sheetId, title, gridProperties). A tab name already in use is a 400.

rowCount.description: Rows in the new tab (Google default: 1000). Set this to at least the number of rows you are about to write.

columnCount.description: Columns in the new tab (Google default: 26, i.e. A-Z).

400.description: Invalid request body, or Google refused the tab (e.g. a duplicate name)

502.description: Google answered with no sheet properties

get.description: Lists spreadsheets accessible to the authenticated user.

parameters.name: maxResults
parameters.description: Maximum number of spreadsheets to return

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query to filter spreadsheets by name

post.summary: Create a spreadsheet, optionally seeded with rows
post.description: Creates a new Google Spreadsheet through Drive, so it can be placed in a shared drive, and optionally writes initialData into the first sheet starting at A1. Answers 201 even when the seed write fails, because the spreadsheet itself exists by then: check initialDataWritten.

parentFolderId.description: Folder to create it in. Omit for Drive root. For a shared drive, use a folder ID inside that drive.

items.description: A cell value: string, number, boolean or null.

initialData.description: Optional rows written to the first sheet starting at A1.

driveId.description: Set when the file landed in a shared drive.

initialDataWritten.description: False when no initialData was sent, or when the seed write failed after the file was created.

initialDataError.description: Present only when the seed write failed.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

404.description: Spreadsheet or calendar resource not found

get.description: Gets metadata and sheet information for a specific spreadsheet.

post.summary: Read a range from a spreadsheet
post.description: Reads cell values from a specified range in the spreadsheet.

range.description: The A1 notation range to read (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:D10')

valueRenderOption.description: FORMATTED_VALUE (default) as displayed; UNFORMATTED_VALUE the raw value; FORMULA the formula text.

post.summary: Write to a range in a spreadsheet
post.description: Writes cell values to a specified range in the spreadsheet.

range.description: The A1 notation range to write to (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:D10')

items.description: A cell value: string, number, boolean or null.

values.description: 2D array of cell values to write

valueInputOption.description: How input data should be interpreted (RAW or USER_ENTERED)

400.description: Bad request - invalid range or values, or the write runs past the tab's grid (Google: "exceeds grid limits"). values.update does not grow a sheet. To retry this write, add rows or columns first with POST .../batchUpdate appendDimension (ROWS or COLUMNS, matching the limit named in the error). POST .../append grows the grid too, but it writes the rows itself, after the existing data rather than at this range — use it instead of this write, not before retrying it.

post.description: Appends rows of data after the last row with content in the specified range.

range.description: The A1 notation of the range to search for data to append after (e.g., 'Sheet1!A:D')

items.description: A cell value: string, number, boolean or null.

values.description: 2D array of row values to append

valueInputOption.description: How input data should be interpreted (RAW or USER_ENTERED)

400.description: Bad request - invalid range or values

post.summary: Apply formatting and sheet-lifecycle operations atomically
post.description: Applies an ordered list of operations in a single atomic batch: if one is rejected, none of them apply. Sheet names are resolved against the live spreadsheet. appendDimension and insertDimension grow the grid, which /write does not do: a tab is 1000 rows and a taller write fails with "exceeds grid limits" until rows are added (or the tab is created at size with addSheet rowCount/columnCount). WARNING: the deleteSheet operation destroys a tab and every value on it, and there is no confirmation step on this plane. alignment sets horizontal/vertical alignment and text wrapping; dataValidation adds dropdowns, checkboxes and number or formula rules (rule.kind clear removes them); addChart creates a native chart from a block with a header row (first column categories, further columns series). Deleting rows or columns is MCP-only.

operations.description: Operations to apply in order. Each needs a `type` plus that type's own fields; see the batchUpdateSpreadsheet MCP tool for the per-type shape.

applied.description: Number of operations Google replied for.

operations.description: One line per operation, in order, for auditing a large batch.

chartIds.description: IDs of charts created by addChart operations, in order.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

404.description: Spreadsheet or calendar resource not found

post.summary: Clear every value in a range
post.description: DESTRUCTIVE and irreversible through this API: clears all values in the range. POST to an action path rather than DELETE on the range, so the call site reads as deliberate. The response reports the range Google actually cleared, which can be wider than the one requested when the request was unbounded.

clearedRange.description: The range Google reports it cleared.

400.description: Invalid request body. The response carries Zod issues keyed by field.

404.description: Spreadsheet or calendar resource not found

get.summary: Inspect cells: formulas, raw and displayed values, formatting, links, notes, validation
get.description: Read-only. Lists non-empty cells only, capped by maxCells. A cell holding several links has no hyperlink; its links are listed under links (from textFormatRuns).

truncated.description: true when maxCells cut the list short.

400.description: Missing or invalid range or maxCells

bearerAuth.description: API key obtained from the registration dashboard

modifiedTime.description: When the spreadsheet was last modified

sheets.description: List of sheets in the spreadsheet

index.description: The index of the sheet within the spreadsheet

rowCount.description: Number of rows in the sheet

columnCount.description: Number of columns in the sheet
